title: Bekhorot 8 - The Wise Men of Athens

chapters.title: Animal reproduction and fish spawn
chapters.about: B'rayta discussing kosher and non-kosher fish, mammals, bats, and dolphins.

chapters.title: The halakha of an egg laid on Yom Tov
chapters.about: Practical halakha learned from the rule that chickens do not lay eggs at night.

chapters.title: Animal intercourse and gestation
chapters.about: Manner of intercourse and the corresponding gestation periods of animals and trees.

chapters.title: The gestation period of a snake
chapters.about: Calculating the seven-year gestation of a snake based on the curse of the snake.

chapters.title: Rabbi Yehoshua and the wise men of Athens
chapters.about: The Roman emperor challenges Rabbi Yehoshua regarding snake gestation and sends him to Athens.

chapters.title: Entering the school of Athens
chapters.about: Rabbi Yehoshua deals with the butcher and outwits the guards at the entrance.

chapters.title: The debates and riddles
chapters.about: The riddles and impossible challenges exchanged between Rabbi Yehoshua and the Athenian sages.

chapters.title: Returning to Rome and the final test
chapters.about: The Athenian sages are brought to Rome, revived with Athenian dirt, and defeated with the swallowing water.

summary: Rabbi Hidary goes through a section of Masechet Bechorot discussing biological rules about animal reproduction, gestation periods, and the curse of the snake. The class concludes with the famous story of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hananiah traveling to Athens and defeating the wise men of Athens in a series of debates and challenges.
subjects: Gestation periods of animals and trees
questions: Can you eat an egg laid on Yom Tov if you checked the nest before the holiday?
What is the gestation period of a snake according to the Sages?
How does Rabbi Yehoshua ben Hananiah outsmart the guards at the school of Athens?
What kind of riddles did the sages of Athens ask Rabbi Yehoshua?
